description: 后对马 — 王后配合围追，吃掉马后获胜

intro.popup_en: A knight's moves are limited, so the queen can drive it toward the edge. Coordinate the white king and queen to pressure the black king and knight, then capture the knight when the chance appears.
intro.popup:
♛♞ 马的弱点：跳法固定，容易被后逼到边角。
白王和后配合逼迫黑王和马，寻机吃掉马b>

outro.popup_en: White is winning. The queen restricts the knight's routes while the king closes in; sooner or later the knight will be captured.
outro.popup: ✅ 白方将获胜！技巧：白后封锁马的跳法，白王贴近施压，马迟早被吃。

moves.popup_en: The white king advances toward the center and closes in on Black.
moves.popup: ♔ 白王向中心推进，逼近黑方。

moves.popup_en: The black king heads toward the center and tries to protect the knight.
moves.popup: 黑王向中心移动，试图保护马。

moves.popup_en: The white king advances again and coordinates with the queen.
moves.popup: 白王继续前进，与后形成配合。

moves.popup_en: The knight checks, trying to disrupt the white king's progress.
moves.popup: 马将军，试图干扰白王！

moves.popup_en: The white king steps out of check and keeps approaching.
moves.popup: 白王躲开将军，继续靠近。

moves.popup_en: The black king follows, keeping the king and knight together as much as possible.
moves.popup: 黑王跟上，马和王尽量协作。

moves.popup_en: The white queen checks and drives the black king away.
moves.popup: 白后将军，驱赶黑王。

moves.popup_en: The black king is forced to retreat.
moves.popup: 黑王被迫后退。

moves.popup_en: The queen controls the f-file and further restricts the black king.
moves.popup: 白后控制f列，进一步压缩黑王空间。

moves.popup_en: The black king retreats toward the edge, leaving the knight isolated.
moves.popup: 黑王退到边缘，马被孤立。

moves.popup_en: The white king reaches e5 and joins the queen's attack.
moves.popup: 白王到e5，与白后形成围攻。

moves.popup_en: The knight checks, making one last attempt to resist.
moves.popup: 马跳出将军，最后的反抗。

moves.popup_en: The white king keeps closing in.
moves.popup: 白王步步紧逼。

moves.popup_en: The black king retreats to the back rank, with less and less room.
moves.popup: 黑王退到底线，空间越来越小。

moves.popup_en: The white king draws near and prepares to finish the hunt.
moves.popup: 白王贴近，准备最后围剿。

moves.popup_en: The knight jumps to f8 with check, trying to escape the pursuit.
moves.popup: 马跳到f8，躲避围追。

moves.popup_en: The white king follows and drives the knight toward the corner.
moves.popup: 白王跟上，逼马退到死角。

moves.popup_en: The knight retreats to d7 with nowhere safe to go.
moves.popup: 马退到d7，无路可走。

moves.popup_en: The queen checks, forcing the black king to move and leaving the knight exposed.
moves.popup: 白后将军，迫使黑王移动，暴露马。

moves.popup_en: The black king moves away, separating itself from the knight.
moves.popup: 黑王撤离，马与王分离。

moves.popup_en: The queen checks again and keeps up the pressure.
moves.popup: 白后再次将军，持续逼压。

moves.popup_en: The black king retreats farther away.
moves.popup: 黑王进一步撤离。

moves.popup_en: The white king captures the knight. The game is decided.
moves.popup: ⚡ 白王吃掉马！大局已定。

moves.popup_en: The black king makes one last attempt.
moves.popup: 黑王最后挣扎。

moves.popup_en: The white king closes in; checkmate is near.
moves.popup: 白王逼近，绝杀在即。
